tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa dang dge bsnyen 'bogs pa'i cho ga snying po rab gsal bzhugs so// so thar gser gyi 'khri shing la chibs gnang bkag 'od dkar dra ba 'gyed/ /srid zhi'i gling bzhi 'khor yug bskor nas bdag blo'i snying gi mun pa sel/ /e ma ho bu ram shing pa'i sras gcig gyur pa u pa li de ni/ /rtsod dus ngur smrig 'chang bzhin byon pa kho bo'i 'dren pas bdag la srungs/ ༈ /'dir skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa tsam 'bogs na/ ming 'di zhes bya ba khyod/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i nang du tshud pa la/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs 'gro ba'i gnad shes dgos pas/ khyod thog mar ston pa sangs rgyas kyi sku 'dra mngon sum du bzhugs pa'am/ yang na mdun gyi nam mkhar ston pa shākya thub pa la 'khor nyan thos dang byang chub sems dpas bskor ba mngon sum du bzhugs snyam pas phyag lan gsum mdzod/ de nas nged la sdom pa 'bogs yul gyi slob dpon 'tshol snyam pas phyag lan gsum mdzod/ da khyed kyi rgyud la skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa skye ba la/ nges 'byung gi bsam pas zin dgos/ de yang skyabs 'gro'i gnad shes na nges 'byung gi bsam pa skye ba lags pas/ bsam pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ sangs rgyas la lam gyi ston pa zhu/ chos la skyabs dngos dang lam dngos zhu/ dge 'dun la lam gyi zla grogs zhu snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ btsun pa dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba/ dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi mchog chos la skyabs su mchi'o/ /tshogs rnams kyi mchog dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ /bdag ji srid byang chub bar du skyabs su 'dzin par zhes pa'i tshig rdzogs ma thag tu khyed kyi rgyud la skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa skye ba yin pas/ de skyes nas/ nged khyed kyi slob dpon du gyur pa yin pas/

slob dpon gyis bzung du gsol/ zhes brjod dgos so/ /zhes brda sbyar la/ rjes zlos gsum pa byas/ slob dpon gyis thabs yin no zhes dang / slob mas legs so zhes brjod du gzhug go /de ltar skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa thob nas/ bslab bya bsrung tshul ni/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su song bas/ phyi rol pa'i lha sogs la zhe dag pa'i skyabs gnas mi 'tshal/ chos la skyabs su song bas/ sems can la gnod 'tshe spong zhing phan ci thog mdzod/ dge 'dun la skyabs su song bas/ grogs mu stegs can dang mi 'grogs/ khyad par du yang sdig pa'i grogs po dang / lta spyod mi mthun pa'i grogs dang lhan cig tu mi 'grogs/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs 'gro dang / dkon mchog la me tog la sogs pa'i mchod pa dang / dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur gyis mnyes pa sogs mchod pa'i las la brtson par mdzod/ de ni theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i lugs kyi skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa tsam 'bogs pa'i cho ga'o/ /theg pa thun mong bas skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa mtshan nyid pa mi bzhed pas/ nyi 'og pa yan chad theg pa thun mong pa ltar skyabs su 'dzin pa'i dge bsnyen tsam du bsgrub pa ni/ 'o na khyod la dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa phog kyang bsrung mi thub pas/ skyabs gsum 'dzin pa'i dge bsnyen tsam du sgrub pa 'di legs pa yin pas/ ston pa la phyag gsum dang / nged la phyag gsum mdzod/ khyod rang pha ma sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob par bya/ de'i phyir du skyabs gsum 'dzin pa'i dge bsnyen tsam du sgrub la/ dge ba ci nus su sgrub/ de yang sangs rgyas la lam gyi ston pa/ chos la skyabs dngos dang lam dngos/ dge 'dun la lam gyi zla grogs zhus te/ skyabs gsum 'dzin pa'i dge bsnyen du sgrub snyam pas/ 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ btsun pa dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba/ dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid 'tsho'i bar du/

rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi mchog chos la skyabs su mchi'o/ /tshogs rnams kyi mchog dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ /bdag ji srid 'tsho'i bar du skyabs gsum 'dzin pa'i dge bsnyen du btsun pas gzung du gsol/ zhes rjes zlos lan gsum byas pa'i/ gsum pa 'di'i skabs su khyod skyabs gsum 'dzin pa'i dge bsnyen du 'gyur ba yin la/ de yang skyabs brjod dang bdag brjod rdzogs/ gzhan brjod kyi mgo rtsom pa'i tshe/ khyod dge bsnyen du 'gyur ba yin pas de'i dus shes dgos te/ de yang / bdag ji srid 'tsho'i bar du skyabs gsum 'dzin pa'i dge bsnyen du zhes pa'i tshig rdzogs ma thag tu khyed der 'gyur ba yin pas/ de'i tshe slob dpon gyis gzung du gsol/ zhes brjod dgos pas/ de ltar yid la zungs la gsum pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod byas la lan gsum pa yang byas/ des khyed skyabs gsum 'dzin pa'i dge bsnyen du 'gyur ba yin/ bslab bya gong bzhin no/ /yang nyi 'og pa yan chad dang thun mong ba'i sna gcig spyod pa dang / sna 'ga' spyod pa dang / phal cher spyod pa'i dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa tsam 'bog par byed na gzhan rnams 'dra ba la/ bdag ji srid 'tsho'i bar srog gcod spong ba'i dge bsnyen du btsun pas gzung du gsol/ zhes pa dang / srog gcod pa dang ma byin len gnyis spong ba'i dge bsnyen du zhes dang / srog gcod ma byin len/ 'dod pas log g.yem gsum spong ba'i dge bsnyen du gzung du gsol/ zhes sogs sngar ltar ro/ /bslab bya ni snga ma'i steng du/ srog gcod spong ba'i bslab bya sogs brjod do/ /yang deng sang grags pa'i kha che ba dang thun mong pa'i yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa 'bogs na/ sngar ltar/ khyod da nas ston pa'i bstan pa la zhugs pa yin pas ston pa'i sku brnyan 'di la ston pa dngos yin snyam pas phyag lan gsum mdzod/

de nas nged la dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa 'bogs pa'i slob dpon zhu snyam pas phyag lan gsum mdzod/ de nas khyed la dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa skye ba la nges 'byung gi bsam pas zin dgos pas/ khams gsum 'khor ba spangs pa'i thar pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i mchog mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa 'thob par bya/ de'i ched du sangs rgyas la lam gyi ston pa zhus te/ gang gis spang blang ji ltar bstan pa bzhin byed/ chos dkon mchog nang tshan lam bden la lam dngos zhus te/ lam bden rjes mthun pa tshogs sbyor gnyis dang / lam bden mtshan nyid pa mthong sgom lam la rim pas 'jug chos kyi nang tshan spang bya mtha' dag spangs pa'i myang 'das la skyabs dngos zhus te/ mthar thug de thob pa gcig byed/ dge 'dun la lam gyi zla grogs zhus te/ grogs tshangs spyod chos mthun gyi grogs dang 'grogs nas lam sgrub par byed/ de bas na dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa blangs te ma shi'i bar du bsrung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ btsun pa dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba dus da nas bzung ste ji srid 'tsho'i bar du rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi mchog chos la skyabs su mchi'o/ /tshogs rnams kyi mchog dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ /bdag ji srid 'tsho'i bar du dge bsnyen du btsun pas gzung du gsol/ lan gnyis byas/ lan gsum 'di la cha gsum du yod pa'i/ dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o yan chad skyabs brjod/ bdag ji srid 'tsho'i bar du dge bsnyen zhes pa bdag brjod/ btsun pas gzung du gsol zhes pa gzhan brjod ces bya ba yin pa las/ dge bsnyen zhes pa'i tshig rdzogs ma thag tu/ khyod kyi rgyud la dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa skye/ nged khyed kyi slob dpon tu gyur pa yin pas/ de'i tshe btsun pa zhes brjod mi rung / slob dpon zhes brjod dgos pas/

de bzhin ma brjed par gyis la gsum pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod byas la/ gzhan 'dra ba la bdag ji srid 'tsho'i bar du dge bsnyen du slob dpon gyis gzung du gsol/ rang gis thabs yin no zhes dang slob mas legs so zhes brjod/ dngos gzhi'i cho ga'o/ /de ltar sdom pa thob pas bsrung rgyu dang bsrungs tshul ngo shes par byas te bsrung dgos pas/ bsrung rgyu ni rtsa ba bzhi chang dang bcas pa'i lnga po 'di yin/ srung tshul dgra bcom pa rnams kyis spang bya lnga po 'di yid kyis spangs/ lus ngag gis slar zlog par byas pa de bzhin du khyed rang gis kyang spang bya lnga yid kyis spangs te/ lus ngag gis slar ldog par bya'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ ji ltar 'phags pa dgra bcom pa de dag gis/ ji srid 'tsho'i bar du srog gcod spangs te srog gcod pa las slar ldog par byas pa de bzhin du bdag ming 'di zhes bya bas kyang / ji srid 'tsho'i bar du srog gcod pa las slar ldog par bgyi'o/ /yan lag dang po 'dis/ bdag 'phags pa dgra bcom de dag gi bslab bya la rjes su slob bo/ /rjes su sgrub bo/ /rjes su bgyid do/ /gzhan yang 'phags pa dgra bcom pa de dag gis ji srid 'tsho'i bar du ma byin par len pa dang / 'dod pas log par g.yem pa dang / rdzun du smra ba dang / 'bru'i chang dang bcos pa'i chang myos par 'gyur ba bag med pa'i gnas spangs te 'bru'i chang dang bcos pa'i chang myos par 'gyur ba bag med pa'i gnas las slar log pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bya bas kyang srid 'tsho'i bar du/ ma byin par len pa dang nas/ 'bru'i chang dang bcos pa'i chang / myos par 'gyur ba bag med pa'i gnas spangs te/ 'bru'i chang dang bcos pa'i chang myos par 'gyur ba bag med pa'i gnas las slar ldog par bgyi'o/ /yan lag lnga pa 'dis/ bdag 'phags pa dgra bcom pa de dag gi bslab pa la rjes su slob bo/

/rjes su bgyid do/ /zhes lan gcig rjes zlos byed du bcug nas thabs legs snga ma bzhin no/ /kha che dang thun mong ba'i yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa 'bogs pa'i tshe bdag dge bsnyen du gzung du gsol zhes brjod pas chog la/ nyi 'og pa yan chad ltar na/ bdag spang bya lnga spong ba'i dge bsnyen du gzung du gsol zhes brjod dgos pa ni grub mtha'i gnad dam par shes dgos te/ kha che ba dge bsnyen yin tshad rtsa bzhi spong bas khyab pa khas len/ nyi 'og pa dge bsnyen pa dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa dang ldan mi ldan gnyis su phye/ ldan pa tsam la'ang rtsa ba gcig tsam spong ba/ gnyis tsam spong ba/ bzhi char spong ba'i sdom pa khas len pa'i gnad kyis so/ ༈ /yang tshangs spyod kyi dge bsnyen 'bogs na/ cho ga gzhan 'dra ba la/ log g.yem zhes pa'i tshab tu/ mi tshangs par spyod pa dang / zhes 'don pa bsgyur bas chog go /de ltar skyabs 'gro tsam dang / dge bsnyen sdom pa 'bogs chog snying po rab tu gsal byed 'di yang / shākya'i dge slong bzod pa rin chen gyis bskul nas/ shākya'i dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa klu sgrub kyis/ thub bstan dge 'phel zhes bya ba/ sa paṇḍi ta chos kyi ma mo'i mdzod gsum chen mos byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas su sbyar ba dge zhing bkra shis// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 mang thos klu sgrub rgya mtsho/ skyabs 'gro dang dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa 'bogs chog PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
